$comment: The shared MCP contract of both Nano Cortex editors (Electron: nano-cortex-editor/mcp/tools.json, the source; native: nano-cortex-editor-mac/mcp/tools.json, a verbatim copy made by scripts/sync-mcp.js). Both helpers serve exactly this list (with $ref inlined); both editors implement every tool with these names, inputs and rules. Change it here first, then copy it, then implement it in both editors.

server.name: nano-cortex
server.title: Nano Cortex Editor
server.instructions:
You control the Nano Cortex Editor, an unofficial desktop editor for the Neural DSP Nano Cortex guitar pedal, which must be open on this computer with Settings → AI assistants turned on. Everything you change is a live edit of the preset that is loaded on the pedal; nothing is stored until the user clicks Save in the editor.

Workflow for a tone request ("a Tim Henson style clean"): (1) read: get_current_preset, list_library kind=capture and kind=cab, list_effects; (2) propose a tone from your own knowledge and explain the choices (capture, cab, effects, rough settings); (3) apply it live with apply_tone on the current preset; (4) let the user listen and adjust by talking, with the single-change tools; (5) when they like it, call save_as with an empty preset number (list_presets shows which are empty) and a name: the editor shows its own dialog and the user clicks; (6) only if nothing on the pedal fits, cloud_search Cortex Cloud and offer cloud_preview (stores nothing) or cloud_send.

Pedal rules: the chain order is fixed: Gate → Pre FX 1 → Pre FX 2 → Capture → Cab/IR → Post FX 1 → Post FX 2 → Post FX 3. Each effect slot takes only the models list_effects lists for it (Pre FX: drives, utility, wah/filter, compressor, pitch; Post FX 1: EQ/utility and modulation; Post FX 2: EQ/utility and delay; Post FX 3: EQ/utility and reverb). Amp knobs (gain, bass, mid, treble, level) are 0 to 10 and shape the capture. Capture slots and cab/IR slots are shared by every preset: use_capture_slot and use_cab_slot only choose which slot this preset plays, but load_capture_into_slot / load_cab_into_slot change the slot for every preset that uses it, so prefer captures already in a slot.

Safety rules the editor enforces: loudness may be raised only in small steps per call (see each tool); switching presets with unsaved edits is refused; tools that store something on the pedal (save, save_as, rename, load_*_into_slot, set_cab_mic, assign_footswitch, cloud_send) open a dialog in the editor and wait for the user's click, and return cancelled when the user says no. Never claim something was saved unless the tool said so. Describe tones as "in the style of" an artist; never imply that an artist or Neural DSP is involved.

errors.editorNotRunning: Nano Cortex Editor is not running, or AI assistants are off. Open Nano Cortex Editor and turn on Settings → AI assistants, then try again.
errors.notConnected: The editor is not connected to a Nano Cortex. Connect the pedal in the editor (Connect in the header), then try again.
errors.busy: The editor is busy with another action (a transfer, a scan or an open dialog). Wait for it to finish, then try again.
errors.cancelled: The user cancelled in the editor's dialog.
errors.unsavedEdits: The current preset has unsaved edits. Ask the user to Save or Discard them in the editor first (or call discard_edits if they say so).

safety.$comment: Loudness limits per call, the same in both editors. An increase above the step is refused with stepRefusal; a decrease is always allowed; the absolute ranges of the schemas still apply.
safety.stepRefusal: Raise {what} in smaller steps (at most {step} per call) so the user can check the volume between steps.
safety.maxRefusal: {what} is limited to {max} when an assistant sets it; the user can go higher in the editor.

prompts.name: build_tone
prompts.title: Build a tone
prompts.description: Build a tone on the Nano Cortex from a description, an artist or a song, using what is on the pedal.

arguments.name: request
arguments.description: What the user wants, for example "a Tim Henson style clean" or "John Mayer's Gravity tone, but darker".

prompts.template:
Build this tone on my Nano Cortex: {request}

Follow the server's workflow: read the current preset, the capture and cab slots and the effects first; propose a tone from what is on the pedal and explain your choices; apply it live with apply_tone; then ask me how it sounds and adjust step by step. Do not save until I say I like it; then use save_as with an empty preset. Suggest Cortex Cloud captures only if nothing on the pedal fits.

tools.name: get_status
tools.title: Editor and pedal status
tools.description: Whether the editor is connected to a pedal, its firmware, the loaded preset (number, name, unsaved edits), whether an audition (Live Preview, cab preview) is playing, and whether the Cortex Cloud tab is signed in.

tools.name: get_current_preset
tools.title: Read the current preset
tools.description: The whole chain of the loaded preset: amp knobs (0–10), capture (slot, name, on, volume in dB), cab/IR (slot, name, factory or user, mic and position, the mics it offers, level, filters), gate, the five effect slots with model, on/off and every parameter in its own units with its range, tempo, and whether there are unsaved edits.

tools.name: list_presets
tools.title: List presets
tools.description: All 64 presets: number (1–64), name (null for an empty slot), whether the slot is empty, which one is loaded, and the four footswitch assignments (IA, IB, IIA, IIB).

tools.name: list_library
tools.title: List captures or cabs
tools.description: kind=capture: the capture slots (slot number and name) and the pedal's capture library (factory and user captures with type such as amp head, combo, pedal or full rig, instrument guitar or bass, and description). kind=cab: the cab/IR slots and the library of factory cabs and user IRs. Optional filters narrow the library part; slots are always listed in full.

type.description: Captures only: a type as list_library reports it, such as amp_head, combo, pedal, rack, power_amp or full_rig.

query.description: Case-insensitive text in the name or description.

tools.name: list_effects
tools.title: List effects per slot
tools.description: The effect models each slot (pre1, pre2, post1, post2, post3) can take, with category and every parameter: name, unit, min, max, step, or the options of a switch. Use these names and ranges with set_effect, set_effect_param and apply_tone.

tools.name: get_slot_usage
tools.title: Which presets use which slots
tools.description: Which presets use each capture slot and cab/IR slot, from the editor's last slot usage scan (scanned: false when there was none); key "0" lists the presets that play straight from the library. scan=true runs a new scan first: it switches through every preset on the pedal and back, which takes about a minute, and is refused while there are unsaved edits.

tools.name: apply_tone
tools.title: Apply a tone live
tools.description: Builds a tone on the current preset in one call, as live edits (nothing is stored). Every part is optional; parts left out stay as they are. Order of application: capture slot, cab slot, amp, gate, cab tone, effects (each effect: model, then parameters, then on/off). Effects not mentioned stay as they are; model "None" empties a slot. Parameters are by name with values in the units list_effects shows. Loudness steps apply as in the single tools. Afterwards the editor reads the pedal back and returns the resulting preset plus one line per change, so you can check what took.

model.description: A model name from list_effects for this slot, or "None".

params.description: Parameter name → value (a number in the parameter's units, or a switch option's text).

tools.name: set_amp
tools.title: Set amp knobs
tools.description: Sets any of the amp knobs (0–10, one decimal) and the capture volume in dB (−24 to +12). Level may rise by at most 2 per call; volume_db may rise by at most 6 dB per call and not above +6 dB.

tools.name: set_effect
tools.title: Choose an effect or switch it
tools.description: Puts a model into an effect slot (a name from list_effects for that slot, or "None" to empty it) and/or switches the slot on or off. A new model starts from its default parameters.

tools.name: set_effect_param
tools.title: Set an effect parameter
tools.description: Sets one parameter of the effect in a slot, by name (as list_effects or get_current_preset shows it), in its own units; a switch takes its option text or index. Level, volume and output parameters may rise by at most a quarter of their range per call.

tools.name: set_gate
tools.title: Set the noise gate
tools.description: Switches the noise gate on or off and/or sets its reduction (0–100 %).

tools.name: set_cab_tone
tools.title: Set cab level and filters
tools.description: Sets the cab/IR level in dB (−96 to +12; may rise by at most 6 dB per call and not above +6 dB), its high-pass (20–800 Hz) and low-pass (1000–20000 Hz) filters. Live edits, kept by Save.

tools.name: use_capture_slot
tools.title: Choose the capture slot
tools.description: Makes the current preset play the capture in a capture slot (1 to the number list_library reports), or switches the capture on or off (slot and on: false together are refused). Does not change what is in the slot.

tools.name: use_cab_slot
tools.title: Choose the cab/IR slot
tools.description: Makes the current preset play the cab or IR in a cab/IR slot (1 to the number list_library reports), or switches the cab on or off (slot and on: false together are refused). Does not change what is in the slot.

tools.name: set_tempo
tools.title: Set the tempo
tools.description: Sets the preset's tempo in BPM, which time-based effects such as delays follow. The pedal takes 40–240 BPM with decimals on firmware 2.3 and later, 30–300 whole BPM before; a value outside its range is refused.

tools.name: select_preset
tools.title: Load another preset
tools.description: Loads preset 1–64 on the pedal. Refused while the current preset has unsaved edits: ask the user to Save or Discard first (or use discard_edits if they say so).

tools.name: discard_edits
tools.title: Undo all unsaved edits
tools.description: Throws away every unsaved edit of the current preset (the user's own too) and reloads it as saved. Ask the user before calling it.

tools.name: preview_cab
tools.title: Audition a cab or IR
tools.description: Plays a factory cab or user IR from the pedal's library in place of the preset's cab, without loading it into a slot (an audition: nothing is stored). Stop it with stop_preview; Save and preset changes stop it first.

tools.name: stop_preview
tools.title: Stop an audition
tools.description: Stops whatever is auditioned (a cab/IR preview or a Cortex Cloud Live Preview) and reads the preset back.

tools.name: save
tools.title: Save the current preset
tools.description: Asks the user, in an editor dialog, to save the unsaved edits into the current preset (overwriting it). Waits for the click; returns saved or cancelled. Refused when there are no unsaved edits.

tools.name: save_as
tools.title: Save as a new preset
tools.description: Opens the editor's Save as dialog with this name and destination preselected (prefer an empty preset from list_presets); the user can change both and clicks to save. The current preset keeps what it had; the pedal switches to the new one. Returns the preset number and name actually saved, or cancelled.

tools.name: rename
tools.title: Rename the current preset
tools.description: Opens the editor's Rename dialog with this name filled in; the user clicks Rename. Returns the new name or cancelled.

tools.name: load_capture_into_slot
tools.title: Load a library capture into a slot
tools.description: Loads a capture from the pedal's library (list_library kind=capture) into a capture slot after the user confirms in the editor. This changes the slot for every preset that uses it (get_slot_usage tells which).

tools.name: load_cab_into_slot
tools.title: Load a library cab or IR into a slot
tools.description: Loads a factory cab or user IR from the pedal's library (list_library kind=cab) into a cab/IR slot after the user confirms in the editor. This changes the slot for every preset that uses it.

tools.name: set_cab_mic
tools.title: Change the cab's mic and position
tools.description: Changes the microphone and/or its position (1 = centre … 6 = edge) of the factory cab the preset plays, after the user confirms: the mic is stored in the cab slot, so it changes for every preset using that slot. User IRs have no mic.

mic.description: A mic name from get_current_preset's cab.mics.

tools.name: assign_footswitch
tools.title: Assign a preset to a footswitch
tools.description: Assigns a preset to one of the four footswitch places (IA, IB, IIA, IIB) after the user confirms. If the current preset has unsaved edits the editor asks about them first.

tools.name: cloud_search
tools.title: Search Cortex Cloud captures
tools.description: Searches Cortex Cloud's Neural Captures with the user's signed-in Cloud tab, like the website's search. Returns product id, name, author, tags, instrument, device and gain type, downloads, likes, a short description, and whether the same capture is already on the pedal. Matching is fuzzy: rank the results and explain. If the user is not signed in, it says so.

tools.name: cloud_open
tools.title: Open a Cortex Cloud capture
tools.description: Opens a capture's page (product id from cloud_search) in the editor's Cortex Cloud tab so the user can look at it. Nothing is sent to the pedal.

tools.name: cloud_preview
tools.title: Live Preview a Cortex Cloud capture
tools.description: Starts a Live Preview of a Cortex Cloud capture on the pedal: it plays in place of the preset's capture and nothing is stored. Stop it with stop_preview.

tools.name: cloud_send
tools.title: Send a Cortex Cloud capture to the pedal
tools.description: Downloads a Cortex Cloud capture and, after the user confirms in the editor's Send dialog, stores it in the pedal's capture library. Afterwards load_capture_into_slot puts it in a slot.

clients.$comment: Display names for MCP clientInfo.name (case-insensitive key). Strip control characters, trim, cut to 60 characters; empty or "unknown" → fallback; a name not listed is shown as sent.

messages.$comment: Texts both editors use word for word ({x} is filled in).
messages.anotherEditor: Another Nano Cortex Editor is already serving AI assistants.
messages.contractMismatch: This assistant's setup is from another version of Nano Cortex Editor. Copy the setup line again from Settings → AI assistants.
messages.nothingToSave: Preset {number} has no unsaved edits, so there is nothing to save.
messages.captureSlotRange: {field} must be between 1 and {count} (the capture slots on this pedal).
messages.cabSlotRange: {field} must be between 1 and {count} (the cab/IR slots on this pedal).
messages.slotOrOff: Give either slot or on: false, not both.
messages.aiExplain: Lets the Claude and ChatGPT desktop apps on this computer read your pedal and make live edits. Saving and anything stored on the pedal still needs your click in the editor.
messages.otherAssistants: Other assistants (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code…): see the manual.
messages.dialogExpired: The assistant's request expired before you answered, so nothing was done.
